days.title: Glutes & Posterior Chain
days.intent: Hip thrusts and RDLs are the two movements that will drive the majority of visible glute change. Everything else is accessory. Progressive overload above all else — beat last session's performance in at least one lift. Right side first on every unilateral movement, every set, every time.

items.name: Glute Bridge March (BW)
items.detail: Neurological activation before loading. Low back flat, posterior pelvic tilt.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.detail: Hip surgery awareness — move within comfortable range only. Assess asymmetry side to side. No forcing.

items.name: KB Romanian Deadlift
items.detail: Intentionally light — you're grooving the pattern, not loading it.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Your #1 glute builder. Full lockout, 1-sec pause at peak. Drive load up weekly — this is the movement to own. Bench under shoulder blades, bar padded across hips.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Bar tracks close to legs, soft knee, hinge deep. Feel hamstring load before initiating return. This is a hip hinge, not a squat.

blocks.label: Unilateral Work · Asymmetry Priority · Right Side First Every Set

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift (KB)
exercises.cue: Right side first every set. 3-count eccentric. Ipsilateral KB hold — same hand as working leg. This is your InBody asymmetry correction exercise. The gap is closing — keep the work consistent.
exercises.note: ↳ InBody asymmetry correction — track RPE difference side to side each session

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.cue: Rear foot on bench. Right leg forward first. Self-govern depth — no impingement. Compare RPE side to side each session. Slow eccentric.
exercises.note: ↳ FAI awareness — depth is self-governed, no forcing

blocks.label: Superset · 3 Rounds · Minimal Rest Between A1 and A2

exercises.name: A1 · KB Sumo Deadlift
exercises.cue: Wide stance, toes out. Drives glute med and adductors alongside glute max. Hinge, don't squat.

exercises.name: A2 · DB Glute Kickback (Bench Supported)
exercises.cue: DB tucked behind knee. Full hip extension, hard squeeze at top. Keep hips square to bench.

recovery.title: Restorative Yoga + Pranayama · 10–15 min
recovery.text: Legs-up-the-wall, supported bridge, supta baddha konasana. 4-7-8 breath or box breathing. This is your HRV tool — not an optional cooldown. Use it.

days.title: Upper Body & Arm Definition
days.intent: Day B is your strength-biased upper day. Compound press and pull at heavier loads build the foundation that Day C then defines. The 3-count eccentric on curls and tricep work is non-negotiable — the eccentric is where definition is built, not the concentric.

items.name: Scapular Push-Ups
items.detail: Serratus activation and scapular stability before pressing. Protract and retract only — no elbow bend.

items.name: Shoulder CARs
items.detail: Controlled Articular Rotations. Full shoulder ROM prep. Slow and deliberate — you know how to do this.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Strict — no leg drive. Builds shoulder caps and triceps — the two muscles most visible in arm definition. Drive load weekly. Bar starts at collarbone, press to full lockout.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.cue: 45° hinge, pull to lower rib. Back thickness and bicep strength from the pull side. Controls posterior chain fatigue from Day A. Squeeze at top, controlled lower.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Full ROM on your flat bench. Neutral or pronated grip. Chest + tricep compound to complement the press pattern. 3-count lower.

blocks.label: Superset B1/B2 · Bicep + Tricep · 3 Rounds · 3-Count Eccentric on Both

exercises.name: B1 · Barbell Bicep Curl
exercises.cue: 3-count lower. No swing. This builds the visible bicep peak — the eccentric is where the growth is. Elbows stay at sides.

exercises.name: B2 · KB Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.cue: 25 lb KB, both hands. Elbows in tight. Full lockout at top. Long head activation — most visible part of the tricep. 3-count lower.

exercises.name: C1 · Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Lead with elbow, raise to shoulder height only. 3-count lower. Medial delt is the muscle that creates shoulder width and cap definition. No swinging.

exercises.name: C2 · KB Renegade Row
exercises.cue: 25 lb KBs in plank. Row one side at a time. Core + back + bicep. Hips stay square — don't rotate to cheat the row.

recovery.title: Restorative Yoga + Pranayama · 10–15 min
recovery.text: Thread the needle, supported fish, eagle arms seated. 4-7-8 breath. Non-negotiable on this program — it's part of the HRV strategy.

days.title: Arms, Shoulders & Core Definition
days.intent: Day B builds the foundation — compound strength, heavier loads. Day C is where you chisel it. Higher reps, tempo-controlled isolation, shorter rest. The goal is local stimulus without systemic cost. This session should never leave you too fatigued to hit OTF or BBC the next day. No finisher — this session is the finisher.

items.name: Arm Circles + Cross-Body Swings
items.detail: Full shoulder range. Build heat before loading the delts.

items.name: Shoulder CARs
items.detail: Same as Day B opener. Slow and deliberate through full ROM.

items.name: Band Pull-Aparts
items.detail: Rear delt and external rotation prep. Until bands arrive: doorframe chest stretch 30 sec each side.

items.name: Dead Bug
items.detail: Opposite arm and leg. Slow. Core activation before loading. Low back pinned to floor.

blocks.label: Shoulders · Medial Delt Width + Rear Delt Detail

exercises.name: DB Arnold Press — Seated on Bench
exercises.cue: Start palms facing you, rotate to palms forward as you press. Full delt sweep — front, medial, and rear all fire through the rotation. 3-count lower only. Don't rush the eccentric.

blocks.label: Shoulders · Medial Delt Width + Rear Delt Detail
blocks.supersetHeader: Superset S1 · 3 Rounds · S1A → S1B → 60 sec rest

exercises.name: S1A · DB Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Lead with elbow, raise to shoulder height only. 3-count lower, 1-sec pause at bottom before next rep. Medial delt isolation — creates visible shoulder width. No swinging.
exercises.note: ↗ Upgrade: banded lateral raise once bands arrive — superior tension at peak

exercises.name: S1B · Rear Delt DB Fly (Bench Supported)
exercises.cue: Seated, hinge forward until chest is near thighs. Arms hang, slight bend in elbow. Raise out to sides, lead with elbows. Squeeze rear delts at top, 3-count lower. Creates the 3D shoulder cap.
exercises.note: ↗ Upgrade: banded face pull once bands arrive — more natural line of pull

blocks.label: Arms · Bicep Peak + Tricep Long Head
blocks.supersetHeader: Superset S2 · 3 Rounds · S2A → S2B → S2C → 75 sec rest · 3-Count Eccentric on All

exercises.name: S2A · Seated DB Curl — Long Head Emphasis
exercises.cue: Sit at edge of flat bench, slight rear lean. Let arm hang slightly behind hip at bottom — stretches the long head in a way the standing barbell curl cannot reach. Squeeze 1 sec at top, 3-count lower. No momentum.

exercises.name: S2B · Sandbag Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.cue: Standing. Both hands grip sandbag behind head, elbows in tight. Full lockout at top, 1-sec squeeze. 3-count lower. Sandbag instability increases long head demand vs. the KB on Day B — this is your progression bridge.

exercises.name: S2C · DB Hammer Curl
exercises.cue: Neutral grip. Hits brachialis and brachioradialis — pushes the bicep up and creates forearm definition. 3-count lower, no swing. Alternate arms or bilateral.
exercises.note: ↗ Upgrade: banded hammer curl once bands arrive — constant tension through full ROM

blocks.label: Arms · Bicep Peak + Tricep Long Head

exercises.name: Bench Tricep Dip
exercises.cue: Hands on bench edge behind you, feet extended. Lower until upper arms are parallel — 3-count lower, full lockout at top. Elevate feet on KB or sandbag to increase difficulty.

exercises.name: KB Suitcase Carry
exercises.cue: One hand, walk 20 steps, switch. Stay tall — do not lean toward the weight. Obliques and QL working isometrically to resist lateral bend. Right side first — hip asymmetry awareness. This is the lateral waist definition exercise.

blocks.label: Core · Anti-Rotation + Lateral Definition
blocks.supersetHeader: Superset S3 · 3 Rounds · S3A → S3B → 60 sec rest

exercises.name: S3A · Dead Bug
exercises.cue: Opposite arm and leg extend slowly to floor — 4-count lower, 1-sec pause before return. Low back stays pinned the entire time. Anti-extension core — trains deep stabilizers without hip flexor dominance.

exercises.name: S3B · KB Plank Pull-Through
exercises.cue: High plank. 25 lb KB to one side. Reach under, drag KB to opposite side. Hips stay square — resist rotation. Anti-rotation under load develops the oblique shelf. Alternate sides each rep.

recovery.title: Restorative Yoga + Pranayama · 10 min
recovery.text: Thread the needle, supported fish, eagle arms seated. 4-7-8 breath or box breathing. Day C's lower systemic load means your nervous system has more capacity to absorb the parasympathetic shift — use it.

ouraProtocol.title: Full Send
ouraProtocol.text: Execute the session exactly as written. This is your day to add load — if all sets felt RPE 7 or below last session, add 5 lb to barbells. Progressive overload happens on green days.

ouraProtocol.title: Modified
ouraProtocol.text: Primary compounds only. Skip supersets and finishers. Keep post-session restorative. Don't add load — maintain what you built. Still a productive session.

ouraProtocol.title: Recovery Day
ouraProtocol.text: No lifting. 20–30 min easy walk + 20 min restorative yoga. Your nervous system is under load — adding more suppresses the HRV you're trying to build. Rest is the training today.

schedulingRules: Never lift two days back to back — any combination of A, B, or C
Day A, B, and C can run in any order based on your week
A heavy BBC upper body day counts as a buffer — don't run Day B or C the following day
If you only get two sessions in a week, prioritize A and B — Day C is the first to drop
Oura Readiness governs load on all three days — no exceptions

progression.name: Foundation
progression.desc: Learn your numbers. Keep RPE at 7/10 maximum. Add 5 lb to barbell lifts only when all sets feel like RPE 7 or below with 1–2 reps in reserve. Log every session. Check Oura daily. Prioritize the post-session restorative — this is where you build your HRV baseline. Goal: Readiness consistently above 75.

progression.name: Build
progression.desc: Add tempo work — 3-count eccentric, 1-sec pause, 1-count concentric on hip thrusts and curls. Increase barbell loads 5–10 lb where form is solid. Introduce drop sets on the B1/B2 superset final round and S2 on Day C. Goal: Oura Readiness averaging 80+ consistently.

progression.name: Define
progression.desc: Reduce rest periods to 60 sec on all accessory work. Full drop sets on hip thrusts, curls, lateral raises. Test near-max on barbell hip thrust and RDL — this is your benchmark. Re-scan InBody at week 12 to measure skeletal muscle change and assess asymmetry progress.

supplements.name: Ascent Native Whey
supplements.detail: Post-workout. 30–40g per serve. Don't rely on appetite — GLP-1 suppresses hunger. Protein is mechanical, not intuitive.

supplements.name: Naked Casein
supplements.detail: Pre-bed via Ninja Creami. Eat immediately after you get home — don't wait until 10–11pm.

supplements.name: Creatine Monohydrate
supplements.detail: 3–5g in morning lemon water. Mix and drink immediately — citric acid degrades creatine if it sits. On pre-workout days: 2–3g only (pre-workout has 1g).

supplements.name: Moon Juice Magnesi-Om
supplements.detail: 1 tsp in water nightly. Add tart cherry juice for Sleepy Girl Mocktail — natural melatonin support.

supplements.name: Naked Energy Pre-Workout
supplements.detail: Weekend morning workouts only. 200mg caffeine — do not use before evening sessions.

supplements.name: Vital Proteins Collagen
supplements.detail: Daily. Connective tissue support relevant to hip repair history.

supplements.name: Rx Cholecalciferol (D3)
supplements.detail: As prescribed. Do not add OTC Vitamin D — you're covered.

supplements.name: Omega-3 Fish Oil
supplements.detail: 1–2g EPA+DHA daily with food. Discuss with prescribing physician given Effexor — complementary, not conflicting, but worth flagging. Not yet confirmed.
